parole.significato: to look, have a look, take a look (+ at)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *kaccodak (compare Estonian katsuma). * (to regard, deem): Semantic loan, ultimately from Latin videō. * ((gambling) to see (a bet)): Presumably a semantic loan from English see.

parole.significato: to turn, reorient (change the direction or orientation of); to turn (around), reverse, invert
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *käntädäk (“to turn; to bend”) (compare Estonian käänama, Veps käta). Semantic development * (to turn): From Proto-Finnic or earlier. * (to invert): Semantic loan from Latin invertō. * (to bend, fold): At least from Proto-Finnic. * (to translate): Attested since the time of Mikael

From Proto-Finnic *rippudak. Cognate to Estonian rippuma, Karelian rippuo, Ludian rippuda, Veps ripuda, Votic rippua and Võro ripma. The -ii- is irregular; expected rippua can be found in dialects. * (to depend, be dependent): Semantic loan from Latin dēpendeō.
